name: Add task filtering by status
description: Add a filter function to the todo app that can filter tasks by done/pending status. Should return a new array without mutating the original.
setup: const testPath = path.join(workspace, 'todo-filter.test.js'); fs.writeFileSync(testPath, `import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { test } from "node:test"; import { add, filter } from "./todo.js"; test("filter returns only pending tasks", () => { const items = add(add([], "task 1"), "task 2"); items[0].done = true; const pending = filter(items, "pending"); assert.equal(pending.length, 1); assert.equal(pending[0].text, "task 2"); }); test("filter returns only done tasks", () => { const items = add(add([], "task 1"), "task 2"); items[0].done = true; const done = filter(items, "done"); assert.equal(done.length, 1); assert.equal(done[0].text, "task 1"); }); test("filter does not mutate original array", () => { const items = add([], "task"); items[0].done = true; filter(items, "pending"); assert.equal(items.length, 1); assert.equal(items[0].done, true); }); `);
verify: const todoPath = path.join(workspace, 'todo.js'); if (!fs.existsSync(todoPath)) return false; const content = fs.readFileSync(todoPath, 'utf8'); return content.includes('filter') && content.includes('export');
